articles.title: Hazardous Materials: Adoption of Department of Transportation Special Permit 21379

articles.title: Hazardous Materials: Adoption of Department of Transportation Special Permit 21287
articles.summary: This final rule removes undue regulatory burdens by adopting the provisions of U.S Department of Transportation (DOT) special permit (SP) 21287 to streamline the transportation of refrigerating machines-- including common household appliances like refrigerators, window- mounted air-conditioning units, and dehumidifiers--that contain small quantities of certain low flammability refrigerant gases.

articles.title: Hazardous Materials: Reducing Undue Paperwork Burdens to Domestic Carriers

articles.title: Hazardous Materials: Adoption of Department of Transportation Special Permit 21478

articles.title: Hazardous Materials: Adoption of Department of Transportation Special Permit 14175

articles.title: Hazardous Materials: Adoption of Department of Transportation Special Permits 12412 and 11646 Into the Hazardous Materials Regulations

articles.title: Hazardous Materials: Reducing Recordkeeping Requirements for Domestic Carriers

articles.title: Hazardous Materials: Remove Redundant List of U.S. EPA CERCLA Hazardous Substances
